HabitCraft Acceptance Tests

51 scenarios in 4 files, copied from acceptance/tests/. Each is the test exactly as written: its title, then its steps, with only await and semicolons removed.

Generated by npm run review in acceptance/. Do not edit; CI fails if it differs from the tests.

accounts.test.ts (16) profile.test.ts (10) habits.test.ts (8) completions.test.ts (17)

accounts.test.ts

Layer 1: test cases, in the language of users and sessions only.

  1. a registered user can sign out and back in

    accounts.test.ts:7
    users.register('Alice')
users.shouldBeSignedIn()

users.signOut()
users.shouldBeSignedOut()

users.signInAs('Alice')
users.shouldBeSignedIn()

  2. an email address can only be registered once

    accounts.test.ts:18
    users.register('Alice')
users.signOut()

users.register('Alice', { expect: 'email-taken' })

  3. signing in with the wrong password is refused

    accounts.test.ts:25
    users.register('Alice')
users.signOut()

users.signInAs('Alice', { withPassword: 'wrong', expect: 'invalid-credentials' })

  4. an open session can be renewed, a signed-out one cannot

    accounts.test.ts:32
    users.register('Alice')
users.renewSession()
users.shouldBeSignedIn()

users.signOut()
users.renewSession({ expect: 'signed-out' })

  5. after a password change only the new password signs in

    accounts.test.ts:41
    users.register('Alice')
users.changePassword()
users.signOut()

users.signInAs('Alice', { withPassword: 'previous', expect: 'invalid-credentials' })
users.signInAs('Alice')

  6. changing password needs the current one

    accounts.test.ts:50
    users.register('Alice')

users.changePassword({ confirmingWith: 'wrong', expect: 'wrong-password' })

users.signOut()
users.signInAs('Alice')

  7. a deleted account can no longer sign in

    accounts.test.ts:59
    users.register('Alice')

users.deleteAccount({ confirmingWith: 'wrong', expect: 'wrong-password' })
users.deleteAccount()

users.shouldBeSignedOut()
users.signInAs('Alice', { expect: 'invalid-credentials' })

  8. registration needs a well-formed email address

    accounts.test.ts:69
    users.register('Alice', { email: 'malformed', expect: 'invalid-input' })

  9. registration needs a long enough password

    accounts.test.ts:73
    users.register('Alice', { password: 'too-short', expect: 'invalid-input' })

  10. an email address as long as the limit allows can register

    accounts.test.ts:77
    knownBug('habitcraft-0roi')

users.register('Alice', { email: 'longest-allowed' })
users.signOut()

users.signInAs('Alice')

  11. an email address over the limit cannot register

    accounts.test.ts:86
    users.register('Alice', { email: 'too-long', expect: 'invalid-input' })

  12. signing in with an email nobody registered is refused

    accounts.test.ts:90
    users.signInAs('Nobody', { expect: 'invalid-credentials' })

  13. an email address signs in whatever its case

    accounts.test.ts:94
    users.register('Alice')
users.signOut()

users.signInAs('Alice', { withEmail: 'in-capitals' })
users.shouldBeSignedIn()

  14. changing password keeps the user signed in

    accounts.test.ts:102
    users.register('Alice')
users.changePassword()

users.renewSession()
users.shouldBeSignedIn()

  15. a new password must be long enough

    accounts.test.ts:110
    users.register('Alice')

users.changePassword({ to: 'too-short', expect: 'invalid-input' })

users.signOut()
users.signInAs('Alice')

  16. a deleted account's habits go with it

    accounts.test.ts:119
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
users.deleteAccount()

users.register('Alice')

habits.shouldNotExist('Morning run')

profile.test.ts

Layer 1: test cases, in the language of a user's own profile.

  1. a user can rename themselves

    profile.test.ts:7
    users.register('Alice', { name: 'Alice Smith' })
profile.shouldHaveName('Alice Smith')

profile.rename('Alice Jones')

profile.shouldHaveName('Alice Jones')

  2. a user signs in with their new email after changing it

    profile.test.ts:16
    users.register('Alice')

profile.changeEmail()
profile.shouldHaveEmailOf('Alice')

users.signOut()
users.signInAs('Alice')

  3. a user cannot take another user's email

    profile.test.ts:26
    users.register('Bob')
users.register('Alice')

profile.changeEmailToThatOf('Bob', { expect: 'email-taken' })

profile.shouldHaveEmailOf('Alice')

  4. a user can keep their own email

    profile.test.ts:35
    users.register('Alice')

profile.changeEmailToThatOf('Alice')

profile.shouldHaveEmailOf('Alice')

  5. an email is kept in lower case

    profile.test.ts:43
    users.register('Alice')

profile.changeEmail({ to: 'in-capitals' })

profile.shouldHaveEmailOf('Alice')
users.signOut()
users.signInAs('Alice')

  6. a profile email must be well-formed

    profile.test.ts:53
    users.register('Alice')

profile.changeEmail({ to: 'malformed', expect: 'invalid-input' })

profile.shouldHaveEmailOf('Alice')

  7. a profile email can be as long as the limit allows

    profile.test.ts:61
    knownBug('habitcraft-0roi')
users.register('Alice')

profile.changeEmail({ to: 'longest-allowed' })

profile.shouldHaveEmailOf('Alice')

  8. a profile email over the limit is refused

    profile.test.ts:70
    users.register('Alice')

profile.changeEmail({ to: 'too-long', expect: 'invalid-input' })

profile.shouldHaveEmailOf('Alice')

  9. a name can be as long as the limit allows, and no longer

    profile.test.ts:78
    users.register('Alice', { name: 'Alice Smith' })

profile.rename({ length: 'longest-allowed' })
profile.shouldHaveName({ length: 'longest-allowed' })

profile.rename({ length: 'too-long' }, { expect: 'invalid-input' })
profile.shouldHaveName({ length: 'longest-allowed' })

  10. a name cannot be blank

    profile.test.ts:88
    users.register('Alice', { name: 'Alice Smith' })

profile.rename('', { expect: 'invalid-input' })

profile.shouldHaveName('Alice Smith')

habits.test.ts

Layer 1: test cases, in the language of habits only.

  1. a new habit is listed

    habits.test.ts:7
    users.register('Alice')

habits.create('Morning run')

habits.shouldInclude('Morning run')

  2. a habit needs a name

    habits.test.ts:15
    users.register('Alice')

habits.create('', { expect: 'invalid-input' })

  3. a renamed habit keeps its history

    habits.test.ts:21
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'yesterday' })

habits.rename('Morning run', { to: 'Evening run' })

habits.shouldNotInclude('Morning run')
habits.shouldInclude('Evening run')
habits.shouldBeCheckedOff('Evening run', { on: 'yesterday' })

  4. an archived habit leaves the list and can be restored

    habits.test.ts:33
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')

habits.archive('Morning run')
habits.shouldBeArchived('Morning run')

habits.restore('Morning run')
habits.shouldInclude('Morning run')

  5. a deleted habit is gone

    habits.test.ts:44
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')

habits.delete('Morning run')

habits.shouldNotExist('Morning run')

  6. one user's habits are not visible to another

    habits.test.ts:53
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')

users.register('Bob')

habits.shouldNotExist('Morning run')

  7. a habit name has a length limit

    habits.test.ts:62
    users.register('Alice')

habits.create({ length: 'too-long' }, { expect: 'invalid-input' })

  8. deleting a habit leaves the other habits' days alone

    habits.test.ts:68
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.create('Read')
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })
habits.checkOff('Read', { on: 'today' })

habits.delete('Morning run')

habits.shouldBeCheckedOff('Read', { on: 'today' })

completions.test.ts

Layer 1: test cases, in the language of checking habits off on days.

  1. a habit checked off today is done today and only today

    completions.test.ts:7
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.shouldNotBeCheckedOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })

habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })

habits.shouldBeCheckedOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })
habits.shouldNotBeCheckedOff('Morning run', { on: 'yesterday' })

  2. a day can only be checked off once

    completions.test.ts:18
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })

habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'today', expect: 'already-checked-off' })

  3. unchecking a day undoes it

    completions.test.ts:26
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'yesterday' })

habits.uncheck('Morning run', { on: 'yesterday' })

habits.shouldNotBeCheckedOff('Morning run', { on: 'yesterday' })

  4. a checked-off day can carry a note

    completions.test.ts:36
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')

habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'today', note: '5k in the rain' })
habits.shouldHaveNote('Morning run', { on: 'today', note: '5k in the rain' })

habits.setNote('Morning run', { on: 'today', note: '5k, new personal best' })
habits.shouldHaveNote('Morning run', { on: 'today', note: '5k, new personal best' })

habits.clearNote('Morning run', { on: 'today' })
habits.shouldHaveNote('Morning run', { on: 'today', note: null })

  5. unchecking a day takes its note with it

    completions.test.ts:50
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'today', note: '5k in the rain' })

habits.uncheck('Morning run', { on: 'today' })
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })

habits.shouldHaveNote('Morning run', { on: 'today', note: null })

  6. a day in the future cannot be checked off

    completions.test.ts:61
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')

habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'tomorrow', expect: 'invalid-input' })

habits.shouldNotBeCheckedOff('Morning run', { on: 'tomorrow' })

  7. each day is checked off on its own

    completions.test.ts:70
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: '10 days ago' })
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'yesterday' })
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })

habits.uncheck('Morning run', { on: 'yesterday' })

habits.shouldBeCheckedOff('Morning run', { on: '10 days ago' })
habits.shouldNotBeCheckedOff('Morning run', { on: 'yesterday' })
habits.shouldBeCheckedOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })

  8. each habit is checked off on its own

    completions.test.ts:84
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.create('Read')

habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })

habits.shouldBeCheckedOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })
habits.shouldNotBeCheckedOff('Read', { on: 'today' })

  9. one user's check-offs do not touch another's

    completions.test.ts:95
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })

users.register('Bob')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.shouldNotBeCheckedOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })
habits.uncheck('Morning run', { on: 'today' })

users.signInAs('Alice')
habits.shouldBeCheckedOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })

  10. a note can be as long as the limit allows, and no longer

    completions.test.ts:110
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })

habits.setNote('Morning run', { on: 'today', note: { length: 'longest-allowed' } })
habits.shouldHaveNote('Morning run', { on: 'today', note: { length: 'longest-allowed' } })

habits.setNote('Morning run', {
  on: 'today',
  note: { length: 'too-long' },
  expect: 'invalid-input',
})
habits.shouldHaveNote('Morning run', { on: 'today', note: { length: 'longest-allowed' } })

  11. a period shows every habit's checked-off days in it

    completions.test.ts:126
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.create('Read')
habits.create('Stretch')
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: '7 days ago' })
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: '6 days ago' })
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'yesterday' })
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })
habits.checkOff('Read', { on: '3 days ago' })

habits.shouldShowDays(
  { from: '6 days ago', to: 'today' },
  {
    'Morning run': ['6 days ago', 'yesterday', 'today'],
    Read: ['3 days ago'],
    Stretch: [],
  }
)

  12. a period shows the days checked off today, and not those undone

    completions.test.ts:147
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.create('Read')
habits.create('Stretch')
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })
habits.checkOff('Read', { on: 'today' })

habits.uncheck('Read', { on: 'today' })

habits.shouldShowDays(
  { from: '6 days ago', to: 'today' },
  { 'Morning run': ['today'], Read: [], Stretch: [] }
)

  13. a period shows only the acting user's days

    completions.test.ts:166
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'yesterday' })

users.register('Bob')
habits.create('Read')
habits.checkOff('Read', { on: 'today' })

habits.shouldShowDays({ from: '6 days ago', to: 'today' }, { Read: ['today'] })

users.signInAs('Alice')
habits.shouldShowDays(
  { from: '6 days ago', to: 'today' },
  { 'Morning run': ['yesterday'] }
)

  14. a new habit is measured from the day it started

    completions.test.ts:184
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.shouldHaveCompletionRates('Morning run', {
  last30Days: [0, 1],
  last365Days: [0, 1],
})

habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })
habits.shouldHaveCompletionRates('Morning run', {
  last30Days: [1, 1],
  last365Days: [1, 1],
})

  15. a day checked off before the habit was created starts it earlier

    completions.test.ts:199
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: '9 days ago' })
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: '4 days ago' })
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })

habits.shouldHaveCompletionRates('Morning run', {
  last30Days: [3, 10],
  last365Days: [3, 10],
})

  16. each rate counts only the days in its window

    completions.test.ts:215
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: '400 days ago' })
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: '100 days ago' })
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: '30 days ago' })
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: '29 days ago' })
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'yesterday' })

habits.shouldHaveCompletionRates('Morning run', {
  last30Days: [2, 30],
  last365Days: [4, 365],
})

  17. a habit's rates count only its own days

    completions.test.ts:230
    users.register('Alice')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.create('Read')
habits.checkOff('Read', { on: 'today' })

users.register('Bob')
habits.create('Morning run')
habits.checkOff('Morning run', { on: 'today' })

users.signInAs('Alice')
habits.shouldHaveCompletionRates('Morning run', {
  last30Days: [0, 1],
  last365Days: [0, 1],
})
